Study 1 reports several Cohen’s d tests: between-group dwell-time bias (d = 0.65), patient bias versus zero (d = 0.61), and healthy bias versus zero (d = 0.16). The broad description plus unresolvable p. 6 locator does not identify the exact contrast. Analytic N cannot be assigned across these different samples.
